scanner.cited: the body coil's peak B1 as Deelchand et al. 2021 (NMR Biomed 34:e4218) state it, the gradients from the vendor's specification (Prisma XR 80 mT/m, 200 T/m/s); the field from the COWS raw headers, 123.26 MHz

measured.statistic: the map's median in the gm cells past 0.95 of the partial volume (scan.maps.MapReading)

records.processing: the map onto the tissues' grid by the affines, linear; the tissues FSL fast of the session's T1-weighted image
records.note: one subject's MPM T1 (variable flip angle, TR 25 ms, 6 and 21 degrees) at NOMINAL transmit: its SE/STE transmit map reads grey 1.03 and white 0.90, a tissue contrast no transmit field has; MPM T1s run longer than inversion recovery at 3 T; CSF not resolved by the protocol, left to the literature
